Cell metadata for the caller

Source: R/cell_meta.R
make_cell_meta.Rd

Builds the cell_meta table of call_scn() (the --cell-meta TSV of call_scn.R). Every column but cell is optional for the caller:

  • cell_type: the depth reference of normal-tissue mode is matched by cell type (types with fewer than 20 cells, and cells with NA, use the reference of all cells). Without cell types the reference is the all-cell one.

  • flat: cells known to be copy-number neutral (e.g. normal cells from an orthogonal assay). Normal mode uses them as the null cells with null_cells = "features"; tumour mode uses them as the reference pool. Without flat, use null_cells = "select" (--null-cells select): the caller selects its own null cells.

  • group: tumour mode only, pseudobulk groups of the phase-block orientation (groups = "group", --groups group), e.g. spatial regions or RNA clusters; NA = all-cell pseudobulk.

Usage

make_cell_meta(
  cells_qc = NULL,
  cell_types = NULL,
  flat = NULL,
  groups = NULL,
  qc_args = list()
)

Arguments

cells_qc

cells_qc.tsv written by the extractor (scphasedcn run; path), its table, or the extraction directory; NULL = the cells of the other inputs

cell_types

NULL, a path or table with columns cell and cell_type (else the first two columns), or a character vector named by cell

flat

NULL, cell barcodes of known copy-number-flat cells (vector, or a file with one cell per line or a cell column)

groups

NULL, a path or table with cell and group (else the first two columns), or a vector named by cell

qc_args

named list of cell_qc() arguments for qc_pass (e.g. list(min_frag = 10000))

Value

data.table cell, cell_type, flat, group, plus qc_pass (cell_qc() on cells_qc) when cells_qc is given

Details

Barcodes are matched as given (a trailing -1 is stripped from every input, as the extractor does).

Examples

qc = data.table::data.table(cell = c("AAAC", "AAAG", "AAAT"), n_clean = c(40000, 25000, 900))
make_cell_meta(qc, cell_types = c(AAAC = "epithelial", AAAG = "immune"), flat = "AAAG")
#>      cell qc_pass  cell_type   flat  group
#>    <char>  <lgcl>     <char> <lgcl> <char>
#> 1:   AAAC    TRUE epithelial  FALSE   <NA>
#> 2:   AAAG    TRUE     immune   TRUE   <NA>
#> 3:   AAAT   FALSE       <NA>  FALSE   <NA>
